matches.quote: Anisotropic QPI is not shown to reflect an anisotropic electronic state rather than an anisotropic scatterer configuration.
As the text concedes, momentum-resolved QPI was not obtained in this sample. So the "consistent with" statement for Sn and Ti doping (p. 6) compares two different observables
No quantitative evidence that the "domains" differ from the anisotropy expected from random, isotropic disorder.
At x = 0.1 the paper's own nematicity marker, the 1/2 Q_Bragg feature, is absent... apply the same metric to x = 0 and x = 0.1
p. 6 calls the state "q = 0 electronic nematicity" while the evidence is a finite-q modulation... state explicitly how a q = 0 nematic state is inferred
Three reasons are given against residual short-range CDW (absence at x ~ 0.1, energy selectivity, slight dispersion), but they are not decisive
The Ti-doped evidence is a lattice-intensity anisotropy over a few nanometres, and its electronic and intrinsic origin is not established.
give the calculation at the measured x, together with how the Fermi level was set; show how robust the M-pocket nesting is to kz and to an energy offset
The "parent state" and "pervasive across the phase diagram" claims are not supported by the measurements shown.
The p. 5 statement that the 1/2 Q_Bragg vector connects "exactly" the M pockets depends on where the chemical potential sits, which hole doping by Sn changes.
define a local nematic order parameter... from lock-in demodulation at the three 1/2 Q vectors with a stated filter length; map it over the full fields of view

notes: C6 asks for inverse FTs of each 1/2 Q_Bragg component over Fig. 3a,c; P20/P21 ask for lock-in demodulation amplitude maps at the three 1/2 Q_Bragg vectors over the full fields of view, which is the same real-space decomposition. C7 calls finite-q unidirectional domains smectic rather than nematic; P17 raises the same tension between claiming q=0 nematicity and observing finite-q modulations. C4 asks whether M-point pockets survive at high Sn substitution; P7 asks for DFT at the measured x and tests of M-pocket robustness to the Sn doping energy offset (judged partly as it focuses on x=0.33 vs 0.25 rather than x=0.68). P2 and P12 are section headers extracted as points.
